process_cpu.scope: Native GetProcessTimes for actual retained process handle; creation/exit are Windows FILETIME (exit unavailable while alive); CPU since process creation through snapshot, not engine-only CPU.

process_memory.scope: OS process counters since process creation, observed at caller snapshot; a terminal pre-exit snapshot excludes subsequent teardown. Working set may include shared pages; commit is not working set.

job.scope: Fresh per-trial Job from assignment; includes assigned process and descendants; does not include pre-assignment startup. Commit is not physical working set.
